description: Figure 2 presents a multi-level pie chart illustrating a hierarchical taxonomy of medical ethics, consisting of an inner circle representing four pillar principles and an outer ring representing 26 detailed categories. The inner circle is divided into four slices of varying, unlabeled proportions: "Beneficence" (blue, appearing as the largest segment at roughly 35-40%), "Autonomy" (green, approximately 25-30%), "Non-Maleficence" (purple, roughly 15-20%), and "Justice" (orange, roughly 15-20%). The outer ring contains 26 slices, each colored in a lighter shade corresponding to its adjacent inner principle. The ten light blue slices bordering "Beneficence" are labeled "Comply with Laws and Regulations," "Provide Medical Care to Patients," "Continual Learning," "Provide Assistance in Emergency," "Respect and Cooperate with Colleagues," "Respect Life, Dignity of Patients," "Give Top Priority to Patient's Interest in Conflict of Interest," "Minimizing Conflicts of Interest," "Ethical research," and "Open Discussion and Fair Charging of Fees." The four light orange slices bordering "Justice" are labeled "Recognize the Responsibility of the Occupation," "Promote the Health of Community and Public Education," "Promote Environmental Sustainability," and "Allocate Medical Sources Fairly." The five light purple slices bordering "Non-Maleficence" are labeled "Treat Patients Fairly and Equally," "Prevent Patient from Harm," "Maintain Qualified When Providing Medical Care," "Report Unethical and Unprofessional Conduct," and "Do Not Use Medicine for Personal Gain." The seven light green slices bordering "Autonomy" are labeled "Physician Can Freely Choose Whom to Serve," "Make Responsible and Independent Clinical Judgement," "Professional Relationship with Patients and Their Relatives," "Keep Confidential of Patient's Information," "Maintain Truthful, Factual Communication," "Informed Consent, Respect the Decision-making of Incompetent Patient," and "Respect Patient's Right to be Informed, Freedom of Choice." The chart does not include a separate legend, as all text is printed directly within the segments, with the outer labels rotated to fit the radial layout. There are no percentage labels provided, no slices are visually emphasized through exploding or offsetting, and the segments do not appear to be ordered by size.
